_what: PLACES WORTH BAKING A ROUTE TO THAT ARE NOT EXITS. The bake plans between exit anchors, because crossing a room is what a journey needs. Working INSIDE a room needs the other thing: routes to the squares the work is at. These are declared rather than derived because the map file does not carry them - a spawn point lives in the .kod, not in the .roo - and because which squares are worth a route is a judgement, not a fact about the geometry.
_coordinates: row,col in KOD 1-BASED SQUARES, the same space exitAnchors emits and the same space walk_to takes. Not fine units, not 0-based.
_how: node tools/m59-routebake.mjs --rooms <n>   (it adopts every other room from the table on disk and refuses to write a hole)
